summary.answer: Initializes the receiver queue, appends one record containing priority, callback and paramData, then pumps only when timedFnQueuePumping equals false exactly. A nil or truthy pumping field does not meet that test. This stores the callback identity; subsequent priority selection, invocation arguments, cancellation and completion depend on the separate pump contract. For CoD.QueueUtility.AddToTimedFnQueue, evaluate the displayed formal inputs and captured values. Its exact paths are 63: if f4_arg0.timedFnQueuePumping == false then. Its writes/requests begin 59: priority = f4_arg1,; 60: callback = f4_arg2,; 61: paramData = f4_arg3.
